title: SyEnergy
description: Reduce the view distance and render distance for AFK players on your Minecraft server to reduce resource waste
body:
# SyEnergy
This plugin is designed to reduce the waste of resources by some AFK players in order to improve server performance.
![Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d59b3b0754618ab85b109f848425bf35eebf7844.png)

You can customize the idle time to enter power-saving mode in config.yml, and set whether the idle is based on health recovery effects.
![config.yml](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/768e9df9a9b117e9485ecf749b6cdc00196e74d2.png)
